texts.arguments: Learned counsel for the petitioner personally undertakes to remove the defects as pointed out by the stamp reporter within two weeks after the lockdown period is over. In view of the personal undertaking of the learned counsel for the petitioner, the defects pointed out by the stamp reporter are ignored for the present. Apprehending his arrest, the petitioner has moved this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail in connection with Jasidih P.S. Case No.205 of 2021 registered under sections 269/270/188/ 332/333/353/379/34 of the Indian Penal Code, Section 20 (1) (2) of Cigarette and Tobacco Production Rules, 2003 and under Section 59 of Food Security Standard Act, 2006. The Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the allegation against the petitioner is that the petitioner used criminal force against the informant- Food Safety Officer, Deoghar and his driver when they were raiding the shop which was selling pan masala illegally and also snatched away the identity card and the seized pan masala. It is further submitted that the allegations against the petitioner are all false.
